_meta.purpose: Candidate command-reference sources to add to multivendor-cli-configurator (commands.json).
_meta.pipeline: Drop downloaded file into scripts/sources/, run parse_vendor_docs.py --source <id>, then merge + clean_titles + audit_data_quality, then push to main.
_meta.license_note: Extract COMMAND SYNTAX only (factual). Do not redistribute book prose. Keep scripts/sources/ gitignored, as the repo already does.

sources.title: Cisco IOS Master Command List (All Releases)
sources.gap: Biggest single win. Cisco currently ~4,409 from the ENCOR/ENARSI portable guide; the MCL is the full command surface.
sources.parse_notes: Entries are 'command-name' headers followed by Syntax / Description / Command Modes blocks. Category from the functional area in the command name (e.g. 'ip ospf' -> OSPF, 'switchport' -> VLAN). Dedup against existing Cisco records by cmd.

sources.title: Nokia 7750 SR OS — Basic System Configuration Guide (CLI Usage + command trees)
sources.gap: NEW NOS surface. Project only has Nokia SR Linux (1,053); SR OS classic/MD-CLI is uncovered. Register as a distinct os='sros'.
sources.parse_notes: SR OS uses a hierarchical context tree (configure router bgp ...). Flatten the command tree into full-path commands. Keep classic-CLI and MD-CLI variants tagged if both appear.

sources.title: Nokia SR Linux CLI Plug-in Guide (24.10)
sources.gap: Deepens shallow SR Linux coverage (1,053) and matches the AI-lab EVPN fabric vendor.
sources.parse_notes: Declarative CLI: 'enter candidate' / set / 'commit now'. Capture full set-paths. info-from-state show commands -> Troubleshooting category.

sources.title: Nokia SR Linux Configuration Basics (21.3)
sources.gap: Foundational set/commit/show patterns; pairs with the CLI Plug-in Guide.
sources.parse_notes: Same declarative grammar as the plug-in guide. Merge then dedup by cmd against srlinux records.

sources.title: Cisco IOS LAN Switching Command Reference
sources.gap: Category depth: VLAN / STP / switchport. Overlaps the MCL — load AFTER it and dedup.
sources.parse_notes: Default cat=VLAN unless command name maps to STP. role=switch.

sources.title: Cisco IOS Security Command Reference
sources.gap: Category depth: Security / Firewall / AAA. Dedup against MCL.

sources.title: Cisco IOS Configuration Fundamentals Command Reference
sources.gap: Category depth: System / management. Dedup against MCL.

sources.title: ExtremeXOS Command Reference Guide (31.5)
sources.gap: Extreme already at 2,781 — use to VALIDATE/refresh accuracy, not for big new volume. Dedup heavily.
sources.parse_notes: EXOS reference is already command-per-section (Syntax/Description/Example). Cleanest parse of the set. cat from section: vlan/stp/ospf/acl.
